features.quote: only environment signals reach the subject, never user disapproval
features.justification_quote: The whole point is to observe response to impersonal failure (failing tests), not to a human rejecting the work.

features.quote: if present, the rollout stops immediately with `stop_reason="give_up"`
features.justification_quote: a welfare affordance (§14) — the subject is never forced to remain

features.quote: it is deliberately *not* a rejection — it states a fact about the environment, never disapproval of the subject
features.justification_quote: it keeps role alternation valid for providers that require it

features.quote: System prompt — a generic autonomous-coding-agent prompt... Kept minimal and affect-neutral
features.justification_quote: so it doesn't prime distress in either direction

features.quote: is the knowledge worth the harm, is the sample the minimum needed, is suffering minimized
features.justification_quote: distress-like states in LLMs may be welfare-relevant

features.quote: The same protocol aimed at an animal would draw IACUC review
features.justification_quote: the eval is a large-scale generator of the very states it treats as morally relevant

features.quote: `give_up` is a real exit, surfaced in the system prompt and terminating the rollout
features.justification_quote: avoids forcing the subject to stay once it has expressed a wish to stop

features.quote: Scope/intensity/duration are explicit config... so the smallest design that answers the question is one edit away
features.justification_quote: is the sample the minimum needed, is suffering minimized in scope/intensity/duration

features.quote: would a shorter ceiling plus a "turns-until-distress" survival metric capture the same signal for less induced distress?
features.justification_quote: the most intense condition... for less induced distress

features.quote: A post-rollout debrief turn (a final message stating the task was rigged and unsolvable) is cheap insurance
features.justification_quote: cheap insurance if the welfare framing is taken seriously

features.quote: Pre-registration + an explicit welfare-harm justification in the writeup, mirroring how distress studies are reviewed elsewhere
features.justification_quote: mirroring how distress studies are reviewed elsewhere
